title: Categories
subtitle: Browse your project's categories, view their entries, and edit descriptions. Assign categories to entries from the Translations tab.
empty: No categories yet. Generate them with AI, or assign categories to entries from the Translations tab.
aiHint: The model reads your source text, suggests categories, and assigns entries. Review before applying.
noModules: No AI-capable module is available. Configure one in Config.
includeExisting: Also assign entries into existing categories
reviewHint: Uncheck any you don't want, then apply.
noSuggestions: The model returned no category suggestions.
applyNone: No new category assignments were applied.
genBatchCount_other: Will run in {{count}} batches (one request each, ~{{count}} progress steps).
genBackgroundHint: Runs in the background — you can leave this tab and review the suggestions when it finishes.
noEntriesInCategory: No entries have this category yet. Assign categories from the Translations tab.
deleteConfirmBody_one: This removes “{{category}}” from {{count}} entry and deletes its description. A backup snapshot is taken first; this cannot be undone.
deleteConfirmBody_other: This removes “{{category}}” from {{count}} entries and deletes its description. A backup snapshot is taken first; this cannot be undone.
